description: Stores the training plan as LOCAL state: a goal, optional start/end dates, phases and planned sessions per date, in ~/.suunto-mcp/plan.json (SUUNTO_PLAN_PATH overrides it). Writes only that file, never contacts Suunto, needs no Suunto credentials and NEVER pushes anything to the watch: to put a planned session on the watch, take its `guide` from get_plan and send it with push_strength_guide / push_week_plan. mode 'replace' (default) is DESTRUCTIVE to the stored plan: the call IS the whole plan (goal required; start, end, phases and sessions left out become empty) and overwrites the stored one, so clients may ask for permission; the result's `previous` is the complete plan it replaced (null when there was none), so nothing is lost and setting `previous` again undoes it. mode 'merge': goal, start, end and phases replace the stored ones when given, sessions are merged by date (a given date replaces that day's session, other dates stay; `replacedDates` lists them); a merge needs at least one field, and a first merge needs a goal. Start and end cannot be cleared in a merge (use replace). A session is { date, title, guide? } where guide is an optional push_strength_guide spec whose `date` must equal the session's. Strict: unknown fields, bad dates, from after to, sessions or phases outside start..end (when both are given), duplicate dates, and more than 20 phases / 200 sessions / 500 characters of text (100 for names and titles) / 8000 characters of guide JSON are refused with an error and nothing is written. A damaged or other-version plan file is refused, never overwritten. Result: { saved, mode, plan: { goal, start, end, phases, sessions } (counts), replacedDates, previous, note }. In demo mode the plan is kept in memory only.

end.description: Last day of the plan, YYYY-MM-DD.

goal.description: The goal of the plan in the user's words, e.g. 'Sub-50 10k in January'. Required unless mode is 'merge' on an existing plan.

mode.description: 'replace' (default): the call is the whole plan. 'merge': update the stored plan; sessions are merged by date.

phases.description: Training phases. In merge mode a given list replaces the stored one.

focus.description: What the phase is about, e.g. 'aerobic volume, 2 strength sessions'.

sessions.description: Planned sessions, at most one per date.

guide.description: Optional strength guide spec for that day (the arguments of push_strength_guide without guideId). Stored only; its `date` must equal the session's.

detail.description: Display string shown on the exercise's set steps, and on the prep screen before it unless 'plates' is given — include weight and sets, e.g. '60kg 3x10'.

last.description: Optional: what was done last time, e.g. '3x8@60kg' (get_exercise_history's suggestion.last). Shown with target in a 'TODAY' popup when the exercise's prep step starts, never in the step text, so lap labels are unchanged. The hint 'Last <last> > <target>' must fit 36 characters: when it does not, last is shortened to its top reps ('10/10/10/10/8@102.5kg' becomes '10@102.5kg'), then dropped so the target stays whole, and if even that does not fit there is no popup (a number is never cut). Not yet verified on a real watch how the popup renders.

plates.description: Per-side plate breakdown for barbell exercises, e.g. '2x20+1x5/side' — shown on the prep screen instead of detail, since that's when the bar actually gets loaded. Omit for non-barbell exercises (dumbbell, machine, bodyweight, cable); compute the math yourself before calling this tool, it isn't done here.

restSec.description: Rest between sets within this exercise, in seconds. With restMode 'countdown' (default) it's the countdown and auto-advance duration; with 'stopwatch' it's shown as a target label only. Not applied between exercises — that's the self-paced prep stopwatch.

restTargetHr.description: Optional target heart rate to recover to during this exercise's rests between sets, in bpm (41-200). Adds a gauge from 40 to this value right after the live HR on every rest step of this exercise (both restModes); it is a visual target only and does not end the rest. Not shown on prep or set steps. Omit for no gauge.

sets.description: Number of sets for this exercise.

target.description: Optional: today's target, e.g. '3x8@62.5kg' (get_exercise_history's suggestion.target). See last.

lapGranularity.description: 'perSet' (default, recommended): one step per set plus one per rest, so laps bound every set/rest individually — needed to read per-set HR and duration from the synced workout. 'perExercise': one step per whole exercise instead, like push_workout_guide — shorter Guide list, coarser data.

restMode.description: Rest between sets. 'countdown' (default): counts down from restSec and auto-advances into the next set. 'stopwatch': counts up and waits for a lap press — the user paces it. Has no effect with lapGranularity 'perExercise' (no between-set rests). Before/between exercises is always a self-paced stopwatch.

title.description: Short session name shown in the Suunto app, e.g. 'Push A'.

start.description: First day of the plan, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: set_plan
title: Set the training plan (local file, pushes nothing)
